tips.text: Radshare the Blueprint relic; four Radiant copies in one squad lift the Rare from 10% to about 34% a run.
Look for Radshares while Gara is in Varzia's rotation; they fill fast then and almost never off-rotation.
Crack relics in Void Cascade or another Omnia fissure; it takes every era, so mixed relics open in one run.
Check the squad's relic and refinement before launch; one Intact relic dilutes the Radiant odds you paid for.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get bonus Void Traces.
Stay in the fissure squad even if nobody brought your relic.
Buy spare relics while Varzia has them; relics already in your inventory keep opening after her stock rotates.
In a friend group, buy and refine one relic at a time and let the next person buy if it misses.
Tell squadmates your Varzia relic exists if the Orbiter relic filter does not list it.
Farm Aya before her rotation opens, not during the 28 days you have to spend it.
Expect a cheap Prime while her window is open: roughly ten Aya per frame set with Radshares.
Treat the wait for her rotation as the cost; nobody describes the farm itself as painful.
